description.zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一。
description.en: A unique business identifier customized by the merchant, used for subsequent troubleshooting. Supports a combination of letters and numbers with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure it is unique.

description.zh:
人像照片Base64编码。

说明
- 如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
- SourceFacePicture与SourceFacePictureUrl二选一。
description.en:
Base64-encoded face photo.

Note
- If you choose this method to pass in the photo, check the photo size and do not pass in an oversized photo.
- Either SourceFacePicture or SourceFacePictureUrl must be specified.
The HTTPS or HTTP URL of the face image.

description.en:

Note

- Either TargetFacePicture or TargetFacePictureUrl must be specified.
